{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Check for duplicate patient_id
df_duplicates = df_filtered[df_filtered['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows after filtering: {len(df_duplicates)}")

# Check sample_seq distribution for duplicates
df_duplicates_grouped = df_duplicates.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Max sample_seq per duplicated patient: {df_duplicates_grouped.max()} (expected: 2)")

# Check if sample_seq is 1 and 2 for duplicates
df_duplicates_sample_seq = df_duplicates.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].apply(lambda x: sorted(x.tolist()))
print(f"Sample_seq values per duplicated patient: {df_duplicates_sample_seq.value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
